references.title: Protect
references.description: Safeguards to manage the organization’s cybersecurity risks are used

references.title: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
references.description: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services, and hardware and managed commensurate with the assessed risk of unauthorized access

references.title: Data Security
references.description: Data are managed consistent with the organization’s risk strategy to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information

references.title: Platform Security
references.description: The hardware, software (e.g., firmware, operating systems, applications), and services of physical and virtual platforms are managed consistent with the organization’s risk strategy to protect their confidentiality, integrity, and availability

references.title: Technology Infrastructure Resilience
references.description: Security architectures are managed with the organization’s risk strategy to protect asset confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and organizational resilience

references.title: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated
references.description: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

references.title: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected
references.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected

references.title: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring
